what_this_is: Every target the unattended worker has scored and every one it declined with the reason attached. One entry per protein, held-out sets built so no two compounds come from the same chemical cluster. Intervals resample targets.
pipeline: Rebuilt under the corrected clustering rule. Every target in the 121 target version was scored before two defects were fixed, and this is all of them computed again.

headline.why_this_metric: Spearman depends on how far apart the true affinities are, so a target whose compounds span four orders of magnitude scores better than one spanning two for reasons that have nothing to do with the model. Fold error does not.
